verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing directly claims it helps you 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI' (docs-7), and it centralizes feedback with voting and a reports analytics engine (docs-15, docs-25). This is a single marketing line, though, with no documentation of how the AI deduplicates, clusters, or prioritizes feedback. Missing for 10: documentation of the AI deduplication/clustering mechanics, explanation of how impact is scored or prioritized, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
